summaryPolicy: Each visible article stores cleaned public publisher-page text. Its one-to-three display bullets are distinct complete sentences extracted from that stored text; the pipeline does not generate or add claims. The display layer translates only those stored sentences and records their hash. Translation failure or a Korean quality failure displays English.
displayPolicy: Only records with a retrievable publisher page, stored source text, distinct extracted sentences, and a source link are visible. Records whose source page cannot be retrieved remain in the cumulative database but are withheld from the feed.
